profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer | Java, Spring Boot, Angular, React | Microservices, Kafka, AWS, Kubernetes | Banking & Fintech Systems
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 6 years of experience building enterprise systems in banking and financial services — from greenfield products I take from design to production, to large-scale platforms serving external banking partners.

Currently contracting at Freddie Mac (via Hexaware) in McLean, VA. I recently built FAST, an asset-tracking dashboard, entirely from scratch — owning the UI design, database design, and full-stack delivery (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL) — and now ship features for TRT, a mortgage fraud referral portal used by Freddie Mac staff and external banks (Angular, Java Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).

Core stack: Java/Spring Boot microservices, Angular/React frontends, Apache Kafka, AWS, and CI/CD pipelines. Oracle Certified Associate Java Programmer. B.S. Computer Science, University of the Philippines.

Open to senior full-stack and Java engineering roles, remote-friendly. U.S. green card holder — no sponsorship needed. Always happy to connect.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contract engagement via Hexaware Technologies.

Client: Freddie Mac.

TRT (Tip Referral Tool) — mortgage fraud referral portal used by Freddie Mac staff and external banking partners to submit and track fraud tips. Building features with Angular, Java Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL; deploying via Jenkins pipelines with Docker on Kubernetes. Shipped commenting, bulk upload, and bulk download for referral records.

FAST Asset Tracking Dashboard — designed and built from scratch a unified dashboard consolidating fragmented legacy sources (flat files, external tools) into a single view of software, hardware, and infrastructure assets. Owned UI design, database schema design, and full-stack implementation (React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL). Delivered to production and handed over to Freddie Mac's full-time team.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Express.js · PostgreSQL · Java · Spring Boot · Jenkins · Angular · Kubernetes · Docker

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Maya Bank, Inc.

- Contributed to the development and maintenance of Maya Bank's Core Banking Services, focusing on the Transaction Service responsible for processing and managing customer financial transactions.
- Implemented system enhancements to improve transaction validation, posting, and reconciliation workflows, ensuring high availability, accuracy, and performance of transaction processing.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate the Transaction Service with other core banking modules, meeting both regulatory compliance and internal security standards.
- Utilized Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, jOOQ, Apache Kafka, and PostgreSQL to develop scalable, resilient, and secure backend solutions for mission-critical banking operations.
(Role concluded due to relocation to the United States.)
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · PostgreSQL · Apache Kafka · jOOQ · Gitlab · Maven · Git · Microservices · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon S3 · AWS Lambda

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a proof of concept program for a custom data migration tool, enabling the migration of customer data from Oracle Database and MS SQL (source databases) to PostgreSQL (target database) for an upcoming banking application. Utilized Java 17, React.js, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Apache Kafka, and Microsoft Power Automate to automate Excel report generation for migrated clients, store reports in SharePoint, and send email notifications upon migration completion.

- Created a proof of concept for synchronizing AWS S3 buckets with SharePoint using AWS Lambda and Microsoft Power Automate, streamlining data storage and access between cloud platforms.

- Contributed to the maintenance and enhancement of corporate financial management systems, including the implementation of key features like the Real-time Electronic Payment System and the Waived Minimum Balance functionality, improving system performance and user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Spring Batch · SQL · Oracle Database · Oracle SQL Developer · Microsoft Power Automate · JavaScript · JUnit · Apache Kafka · Git · Gitlab · Gradle · Amazon S3 · AWS Lambda · SharePoint

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Project: myCWT RAIL
- Developed scalable microservices using Java and the Spring Framework, ensuring high performance and modularity.
- Integrated microservices with Apache Kafka and Spring Cloud Stream for real-time data streaming and messaging.
- Automated deployment pipelines for microservices using Jenkins, improving deployment efficiency.
- Provided ongoing support for maintenance and resolved production issues, minimizing downtime and ensuring service continuity.
- Wrote comprehensive unit tests with JUnit and Mockito, achieving high code coverage and ensuring code reliability.
- Strengthened software security by conducting Static Code Analysis using Veracode to identify and address vulnerabilities.
- Stepped in as Deputy Team Lead and Scrum Master, facilitating Agile ceremonies and managing team workflows to ensure timely project delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: Mockito · Spring Boot · Veracode Platform · Java · SQL · JavaScript · JUnit · Apache Kafka · Jenkins · Spring Framework · Sonarqube · REST APIs

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Rhythm for Commerce
- Developed backend services and search engine APIs using Java, SQL, and Elasticsearch to enhance data retrieval and application performance.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate systems using Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, enabling real-time data processing and analytics.
- Provided production support and maintenance, quickly resolving issues to ensure system stability and uptime.
- Designed and implemented load testing scripts with Python to assess system performance under varying workloads.
- Wrote and maintained unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito, ensuring robust and reliable code with extensive test coverage.
positions.insights: Skills: Kibana · Mockito · PostgreSQL · Spring Boot · Veracode Platform · Java · SQL · JavaScript · JUnit · Microsoft SQL Server · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · Jenkins · Elasticsearch · REST APIs · Python (Programming Language)
